meta.title: Burmese Alphabet
meta.subtitle: 79 letters, tones and signs · both directions, as two cards each
meta.desc: The Myanmar script in which Burmese is written: 79 notes. The first deck of the Burmese collection. The script is an abugida: a consonant letter carries the vowel a, and every other vowel, the tone, a medial consonant and a final are marks written around it. The deck teaches the 33 consonants in the traditional order (the five groups of five, then the eight without a group), each with its sound, its traditional name (ကကြီး 'big ka') and the commonest word that begins with it; then the four tones (low à, high á, creaky a̰, checked aʔ — the marks the reading under every word in the level decks uses), the seven vowels in their three tones, the four medials (ျ ြ ွ ှ), the closed syllables that end in a glottal stop or a nasal, the asat, the anusvara and the stacking sign, the independent vowel letters, the digits and the punctuation. Both directions: see a letter and recall its sound, or see a sound and recall the letter, each a card with its own schedule. Several letters say the same sound (ယ and ရ are both y; ten letters kept for words from Pali and Sanskrit double others), so the sound side names each letter too. The sounds are given in IPA, as the level decks give them, and in the usual learner's approximations in English words. There is no speaker button: few devices have a Burmese voice. Sources: Wikipedia, 'Burmese alphabet' (the letters, names, sounds, spellings and rhymes) and 'Burmese language' § Tones, read 2026-11-15; the example words, their readings and meanings are English Wiktionary's, via the kaikki.org extraction (CC BY-SA 4.0), chosen by their frequency in the Burmese Wikipedia.

fields.Row: ကာkàကီkìကူkù
fields.Sound: k · /k/ · named ကကြီး (ka̰ dʑí), ka group · k without a puff of breath, as in "skin"
fields.Example: ကိုkòindicates a direct or indirect object

fields.Row: ခါkʰàခီkʰìခူkʰù
fields.Sound: kh · /kʰ/ · named ခခွေး (kʰa̰ ɡwé), ka group · k with a puff of breath, as in "kin"
fields.Example: ခဲ့kʰɛ̰particle suffixed to verbs to emphasize definitiveness of an action or condition

fields.Row: ဂါɡàဂီɡìဂူɡù
fields.Sound: g · /ɡ/ · named ဂငယ် (ɡa̰ ŋɛ̀), ka group · g, as in "go"
fields.Example: ဂုဏ်ɡòʊɴqualities, characteristics, attributes

fields.Row: ဃာɡàဃီɡìဃူɡù
fields.Sound: gh · /ɡ/ · named ဃကြီး (ɡa̰ dʑí), ka group · g, said exactly as ဂ; a letter kept for words from Pali and Sanskrit

fields.Row: ငါŋàငီŋìငူŋù
fields.Sound: ng · /ŋ/ · named င (ŋa̰), ka group · ng, as in "singer" -- in Burmese also at the start of a word

fields.Row: စာsàစီsìစူsù
fields.Sound: c · /s/ · named စလုံး (sa̰ lóʊɴ), sa group · s without a puff of breath
fields.Example: စတင်sa̰tɪ̀ɴto begin, start, commence

fields.Row: ဆာsʰàဆီsʰìဆူsʰù
fields.Sound: ch · /sʰ/ · named ဆလိမ် (sʰa̰ lèɪɴ), sa group · s with a puff of breath after it
fields.Example: ဆက်sʰɛʔto join, connect

fields.Row: ဇာzàဇီzìဇူzù
fields.Sound: j · /z/ · named ဇကွဲ (za̰ ɡwɛ́), sa group · z, as in "zoo"

fields.Row: ဈာzàဈီzìဈူzù
fields.Sound: jh · /z/ · named ဈမျဉ်းဆွဲ (za̰ mjɪ̀ɴ zwɛ́), sa group · z, said exactly as ဇ; a letter kept for words from Pali and Sanskrit

fields.Row: ညာɲàညီɲìညူɲù
fields.Sound: ny · /ɲ/ · named ညကြီး (ɲa̰ dʑí), sa group · ny, as in "canyon"; written ဉ in some words

fields.Row: ဋာtàဋီtìဋူtù
fields.Sound: ṭ · /t/ · named ဋသန်လျင်းချိတ် (ta̰ təlɪ́ɴ dʑeɪʔ), ṭa group · t, said as တ; a letter kept for words from Pali and Sanskrit

fields.Row: ဌာtʰàဌီtʰìဌူtʰù
fields.Sound: ṭh · /tʰ/ · named ဌဝမ်းဘဲ (tʰa̰ wʊ́ɴ bɛ́), ṭa group · t with a puff of breath, said as ထ; a letter kept for words from Pali and Sanskrit

fields.Row: ဍာdàဍီdìဍူdù
fields.Sound: ḍ · /d/ · named ဍရင်ကောက် (da̰ jɪ̀ɴ ɡaʊʔ), ṭa group · d, said as ဒ; a letter kept for words from Pali and Sanskrit
fields.Example: ဍရင်ကောက်da̰jɪ̀ɴɡaʊʔan edible species of climbing fern

fields.Row: ဎာdàဎီdìဎူdù
fields.Sound: ḍh · /d/ · named ဎရေမှုတ် (da̰ jè m̥oʊʔ), ṭa group · d, said as ဒ; a letter kept for words from Pali and Sanskrit

fields.Row: ဏာnàဏီnìဏူnù
fields.Sound: ṇ · /n/ · named ဏကြီး (na̰ dʑí), ṭa group · n, said as န; a letter kept for words from Pali and Sanskrit

fields.Row: တာtàတီtìတူtù
fields.Sound: t · /t/ · named တဝမ်းပူ (ta̰ wʊ́ɴ bù), ta group · t without a puff of breath, as in "stop"

fields.Row: ထာtʰàထီtʰìထူtʰù
fields.Sound: th · /tʰ/ · named ထဆင်ထူး (tʰa̰ sʰɪ̀ɴ dú), ta group · t with a puff of breath, as in "top" (never the th of "thin")

fields.Row: ဒါdàဒီdìဒူdù
fields.Sound: d · /d/ · named ဒထွေး (da̰ dwé), ta group · d, as in "do"

fields.Row: ဓာdàဓီdìဓူdù
fields.Sound: dh · /d/ · named ဓအောက်ခြိုက် (da̰ ʔaʊʔ tɕʰaɪʔ), ta group · d, said as ဒ; a letter kept for words from Pali and Sanskrit
fields.Example: ဓာတ်ပုံdaʔpòʊɴphotograph

fields.Row: နာnàနီnìနူnù
fields.Sound: n · /n/ · named နငယ် (na̰ ŋɛ̀), ta group · n, as in "no"; written with a shorter tail when a mark goes below it (နု)

fields.Row: ပါpàပီpìပူpù
fields.Sound: p · /p/ · named ပစောက် (pa̰ zaʊʔ), pa group · p without a puff of breath, as in "spin"

fields.Row: ဖာpʰàဖီpʰìဖူpʰù
fields.Sound: ph · /pʰ/ · named ဖဦးထုပ် (pʰa̰ ʔóʊʔ tʰoʊʔ), pa group · p with a puff of breath, as in "pin"
fields.Example: ဖော်ပြpʰɔ̀pja̰to show, reveal, describe

fields.Row: ဗာbàဗီbìဗူbù
fields.Sound: b · /b/ · named ဗထက်ခြိုက် (ba̰ tɛʔ tɕʰaɪʔ), pa group · b, as in "boy"
fields.Example: ဗိုက်baɪʔstomach, belly

fields.Row: ဘာbàဘီbìဘူbù
fields.Sound: bh · /b/ · named ဘကုန်း (ba̰ ɡóʊɴ), pa group · b, said as ဗ; Indic in origin, but common in Burmese words too

fields.Row: မာmàမီmìမူmù
fields.Sound: m · /m/ · named မ (ma̰), pa group · m, as in "me"

fields.Row: ယာjàယီjìယူjù
fields.Sound: y · /j/ · named ယပက်လက် (ja̰ pɛʔ lɛʔ), without a group · y, as in "yes"

fields.Row: ရာjàရီjìရူjù
fields.Sound: r · /j/ · named ရကောက် (ja̰ ɡaʊʔ), without a group · y, as in "yes", like ယ -- but often r in words from Pali or English

fields.Row: လာlàလီlìလူlù
fields.Sound: l · /l/ · named လငယ် (la̰ ŋɛ̀), without a group · l, as in "let"

fields.Row: ဝါwàဝီwìဝူwù
fields.Sound: w · /w/ · named ဝ (wa̰), without a group · w, as in "wet"

fields.Row: သာθàသီθìသူθù
fields.Sound: s · /θ/ · named သ (θa̰), without a group · th, as in "thin" (and as in "this" when voiced inside a word)
fields.Example: သူθùhe or she

fields.Row: ဟာhàဟီhìဟူhù
fields.Sound: h · /h/ · named ဟ (ha̰), without a group · h, as in "hat"
fields.Example: ဟုတ်hoʊʔto be true, to be the case, to be so, to be a fact

fields.Row: ဠာlàဠီlìဠူlù
fields.Sound: ḷ · /l/ · named ဠကြီး (la̰ dʑí), without a group · l, said as လ; a letter kept for words from Pali and Sanskrit

fields.Row: အာʔàအီʔìအူʔù
fields.Sound: a · /ʔ/ · named အ (ʔa̰), without a group · a glottal stop, the catch in "uh-oh": the letter that carries a vowel when a syllable has no other consonant

fields.Letter: ခါ ခါး ခ ခတ်
fields.Row: ခါkʰà
fields.Sound: à · the low tone: modal voice, a low and level or slightly rising pitch, medium length. ခါ kʰà means "shake"

fields.Letter: ခါ ခါး ခ ခတ်
fields.Row: ခါးkʰá
fields.Sound: á · the high tone: a high pitch, long, sometimes slightly breathy, often falling before a pause. ခါး kʰá means "be bitter"

fields.Letter: ခါ ခါး ခ ခတ်
fields.Row: ခkʰa̰
fields.Sound: a̰ · the creaky tone: tense or creaky voice, high and often slightly falling, sometimes with a light catch. ခ kʰa̰ means "to wait upon"

fields.Letter: ခါ ခါး ခ ခတ်
fields.Row: ခတ်kʰaʔ
fields.Sound: aʔ · the checked tone: short, high, ending in a glottal stop, the vowel a little centralised. ခတ် kʰaʔ means "to beat, to strike"

fields.Row: ကka̰ကာkàကားká
fields.Sound: a · the vowel a, as in "father", in its three tones (creaky, low, high), written no mark (the inherent vowel); ာ (written ါ after ခ ဂ င ဒ ပ ဝ); ား

fields.Row: ကဲ့kɛ̰ကယ်kɛ̀ကဲkɛ́
fields.Sound: ɛ · the vowel e, as in "bed", in its three tones (creaky, low, high), written ဲ့; ယ်; ဲ

fields.Row: ကိkḭကီkìကီးkí
fields.Sound: i · the vowel ee, as in "see", in its three tones (creaky, low, high), written ိ; ီ; ီး

fields.Row: ကုkṵကူkùကူးkú
fields.Sound: u · the vowel oo, as in "food", in its three tones (creaky, low, high), written ု; ူ; ူး

fields.Row: ကေ့kḛကေkèကေးké
fields.Sound: e · the vowel e, as in French "été": one pure vowel, no glide into "ee", in its three tones (creaky, low, high), written ေ့; ေ; ေး (ေ is written before the consonant and said after it)

fields.Row: ကော့kɔ̰ကော်kɔ̀ကောkɔ́
fields.Sound: ɔ · the vowel aw, as in "law", in its three tones (creaky, low, high), written ော့; ော်; ော

fields.Row: ကို့ko̰ကိုkòကိုးkó
fields.Sound: o · the vowel o, as in "go", but one pure vowel, in its three tones (creaky, low, high), written ို့; ို; ိုး

fields.Row: မျပျကျချ
fields.Sound: ya pin · the medial ယပင့်: y after the consonant (မျ mj); after က ခ ဂ it makes them ch- and j-like (ကျ tɕ, ချ tɕʰ, ဂျ dʑ)

fields.Row: မြပြကြခြ
fields.Sound: ya yit · the medial ရရစ်: y after the consonant, as ျ does: မြ mj, and ကြ ခြ ဂြ are said tɕ tɕʰ dʑ

fields.Row: မွကွသွဆွ
fields.Sound: wa hswe · the medial ဝဆွဲ: w after the consonant (မွ mw); in a closed syllable the vowel ʊ

fields.Row: မှနှလှရှ
fields.Sound: ha hto · the medial ဟထိုး: makes m n ng ny l voiceless, a breathy h-sound (မှ m̥, နှ n̥, လှ l̥); ယှ and ရှ are said sh

fields.Row: ကက်kɛʔ
fields.Sound: -ɛʔ · a closed syllable ending in a glottal stop (the checked tone), spelt ကက်: the written final consonant is no longer said, only the catch

fields.Row: ကစ်kɪʔ
fields.Sound: -ɪʔ · a closed syllable ending in a glottal stop (the checked tone), spelt ကစ်: the written final consonant is no longer said, only the catch

fields.Row: ကတ်kaʔကပ်kaʔ
fields.Sound: -aʔ · a closed syllable ending in a glottal stop (the checked tone), spelt ကတ် or ကပ်: the written final consonant is no longer said, only the catch

fields.Row: ကွတ်kʊʔကွပ်kʊʔ
fields.Sound: -ʊʔ · a closed syllable ending in a glottal stop (the checked tone), spelt ကွတ် or ကွပ်: the written final consonant is no longer said, only the catch

fields.Row: ကိတ်keɪʔကိပ်keɪʔ
fields.Sound: -eɪʔ · a closed syllable ending in a glottal stop (the checked tone), spelt ကိတ် or ကိပ်: the written final consonant is no longer said, only the catch

fields.Row: ကုတ်koʊʔကုပ်koʊʔ
fields.Sound: -oʊʔ · a closed syllable ending in a glottal stop (the checked tone), spelt ကုတ် or ကုပ်: the written final consonant is no longer said, only the catch

fields.Row: ကောက်kaʊʔ
fields.Sound: -aʊʔ · a closed syllable ending in a glottal stop (the checked tone), spelt ကောက်: the written final consonant is no longer said, only the catch

fields.Row: ကိုက်kaɪʔ
fields.Sound: -aɪʔ · a closed syllable ending in a glottal stop (the checked tone), spelt ကိုက်: the written final consonant is no longer said, only the catch

fields.Row: ကင်kɪ̀ɴကဉ်kɪ̀ɴ
fields.Sound: -ɪɴ · a syllable ending in a nasal (written ɴ: the vowel nasalised, no clear n or m), spelt ကင် or ကဉ်; in the low tone as written, creaky with ့, high with း

fields.Row: ကန်kàɴကမ်kàɴကံkàɴ
fields.Sound: -aɴ · a syllable ending in a nasal (written ɴ: the vowel nasalised, no clear n or m), spelt ကန် or ကမ် or ကံ; in the low tone as written, creaky with ့, high with း

fields.Row: ကိန်kèɪɴကိမ်kèɪɴကိံkèɪɴ
fields.Sound: -eɪɴ · a syllable ending in a nasal (written ɴ: the vowel nasalised, no clear n or m), spelt ကိန် or ကိမ် or ကိံ; in the low tone as written, creaky with ့, high with း

fields.Row: ကုန်kòʊɴကုမ်kòʊɴကုံkòʊɴ
fields.Sound: -oʊɴ · a syllable ending in a nasal (written ɴ: the vowel nasalised, no clear n or m), spelt ကုန် or ကုမ် or ကုံ; in the low tone as written, creaky with ့, high with း

fields.Row: ကောင်kàʊɴ
fields.Sound: -aʊɴ · a syllable ending in a nasal (written ɴ: the vowel nasalised, no clear n or m), spelt ကောင်; in the low tone as written, creaky with ့, high with း

fields.Row: ကိုင်kàɪɴ
fields.Sound: -aɪɴ · a syllable ending in a nasal (written ɴ: the vowel nasalised, no clear n or m), spelt ကိုင်; in the low tone as written, creaky with ့, high with း

fields.Row: ကွန်kʊ̀ɴကွမ်kʊ̀ɴ
fields.Sound: -ʊɴ · a syllable ending in a nasal (written ɴ: the vowel nasalised, no clear n or m), spelt ကွန် or ကွမ်; in the low tone as written, creaky with ့, high with း

fields.Row: ကက်kɛʔကန်kàɴကယ်kɛ̀
fields.Sound: asat · အသတ်, "no vowel": it kills the inherent a and makes the letter a final; on ယ and ော it marks the low tone

fields.Row: ကံkàɴကုံkòʊɴ
fields.Sound: anusvara · သေးသေးတင်: a nasal final, like မ် (low tone; with ့ or း creaky or high), and in a longer word a nasal before the next consonant

fields.Row: မင်္ဂလာmɪ̀ɴɡəlàဗုဒ္ဓboʊʔda̰
fields.Sound: stacking · a consonant written small under another (ဒ္ဓ) is the final of one syllable and the start of the next; the kinzi င်္, a small mark above, is an ng final; both mostly in words from Pali

fields.Row: ဣʔḭဤʔìဥʔṵဦʔùဧʔèဩʔɔ́ဪʔɔ̀
fields.Sound: independent vowels · seven letters that write a vowel with no consonant, mostly in words from Pali and Sanskrit: ဣ = အိ, ဤ = အီ, ဥ = အု, ဦ = အူ, ဧ = အေ, ဩ = အော, ဪ = အော်
0 · the digit 0
1 · the digit 1
2 · the digit 2
3 · the digit 3
4 · the digit 4
5 · the digit 5
6 · the digit 6
fields.Example: ခြောက်t͡ɕʰaʊʔsix

fields.Sound: 7 · the digit 7
8 · the digit 8
9 · the digit 9
, . · the punctuation: ၊ is a comma (a break inside a sentence) and ။ ends a sentence, a full stop

fields.Row: ၏ʔḭ၍jwḛ၌n̥aɪʔ၎င်းləɡáʊɴ
fields.Sound: literary signs · single signs for particles of written Burmese: ၏ "of" (also a full stop after a verb), ၍ "and", ၌ "at", and ၎င်း "ditto, the same"
